title: 第3章 有妖气第4章 像煮熟的大虾
slug: 重生后长公主只想种田
content_zh:
;;
“云珏，你也莫要怪我太过无情，毕竟如今的你不过是个残废，如何能配得上我。若是真的为我好，就该接了这退婚书。”
“没错，我妹妹如今玄阶巅峰，被镇妖殿殿主收为大弟子，你个废人如何配得上。”
“我知道是你救了我，可你不能拿救命之恩来强迫我。”
……
周遭围着的人小声议论，沈青鱼一边竖着耳朵去听着，一边朝人群中那个坐在轮椅上，始终不发一言的青年望去。
这云珏，长得还挺好看的。
前世她见过的美男无数，都不及他。
小梨小声嘀咕：“要我说，这汪家人也真够忘恩负义的，云大公子之所以会变成如今这模样，还不是为了救汪雪，结果人前脚刚被宣告残废，后脚就急着上门退婚了。连门都还没进，就迫不及待说上了，明显是要在众目睽睽之下把云大公子的脸撕下往地上踩啊。”
沈青鱼双手抱胸：“人家自己都不急，你急什么？”
头顶传来声音【有没有一种可能，他不是不急，而是被冻住了，再着急也吱不了声？】
小梨听不到这声音，气呼呼道：“殿下您不喜武道，可能还不知道，这云大公子武道天赋极好，是千年难得一见的绝世天才，若非出了这档子事，说不准都已经开始闭关凝结武道金丹了。”
沈青鱼掏出个帕子擦汗：“你说的没错，可如今这天才沦为废材，连他们家自己人都不管，又何况是外人。”
小梨看了下大门紧闭的云家，一时哑口无言。
云大公子光芒万丈时一个个都舔着脸来沾光，光芒消失后便弃如敝履。连自家人都如此，又何况是外人。
“可惜了，一代天才就此陨落。”
“这不关我们的事，热死了，赶紧走，去寒潭。”
“其实殿下要去的那个寒潭，原本是有条寒冰蛟的，若非云大公子以命相搏将它斩杀，殿下说不准还泡不上呢。而云大公子落入此境地，就是因为这寒冰蛟。”
沈青鱼微愣，诧异竟然还有这事。
不过这似乎与她无关，身上热得很，那火灵草不太对劲，她得赶紧去泡寒潭。

正往人群外挤，头顶忽然传来声音，听着有些急切。
【等等。】
有什么东西从头顶飞了过去，沈青鱼定睛看了看，果然如她猜测的那般，大渊龙脉成精了。
她没吱声，眼神示意小梨动作快些。
等小龙脉围着云珏转了几圈再飞回来，发现人没了，它顿时就傻了眼。
【尊上呢，窝辣么大一个尊上呢？】
（ㄒoㄒ）~~
沈青鱼溜得贼快，心里头直泛嘀咕：好家伙，既生了灵智，为何不去跟着大渊新皇，反而跑来跟着她一个柔弱不能自理小白花？
马车刚驶出城门，天空突然就暗了下来，紧接着狂风骤起。
眼见着就要下雨，他们不得不寻了个地方停下避雨。
年久失修的八角亭，挡得住雨挡不住风，沈青鱼被这股风刮得东倒西歪，被蓝影与小梨一左一右扶着，才没被风给刮倒，就是这脸被刮得有点疼，五官乱飞。
“这城外的天，真是越来越多变了。”小梨嘀咕。
蓝影没说话，眼神警惕地扫视四周。
往往这种时候，最容易有妖魔作乱。
好不容易风止住了，又开始大雨倾沱，仿佛这天被捅破了一般。

"Yunjue, don't blame me for being too ruthless. After all, you are just a cripple now. How can you be worthy of me? If you are really good for me, you should accept this divorce letter."
"That's right, my sister is now at the peak of the Xuan level and has been accepted as the eldest disciple by the master of the Demon Suppression Hall. How can you, a useless person, be worthy of her?"
"I know you saved me, but you can't force me to save my life."
…
The people around him were talking in low voices. Shen Qingyu listened with his ears perked up, while looking at the young man in the crowd who was sitting in a wheelchair and remained silent.
This Yun Jue is pretty good-looking.
She had seen countless beautiful men in her previous life, but none of them were as good as him.
Xiao Li muttered in a low voice: "If you ask me, the Wang family is really ungrateful. The reason why Mr. Yun became like this was not to save Wang Xue. As a result, as soon as the front leg was declared disabled, the back leg rushed to the door to break off the engagement. He couldn't wait to break the engagement before even entering the door. It was obvious that he wanted to tear off Mr. Yun's face and stomp it on the ground in front of everyone."
Shen Qingyu crossed his arms and said, "I'm not in a hurry myself, why are you in a hurry?"
A voice came from above his head [Is there a possibility that he is not in a hurry, but is frozen, and can't make a sound no matter how anxious he is? 】
Xiaoli couldn't hear the voice and said angrily: "Your Highness, you don't like martial arts. Maybe you don't know yet. Young Master Yun is extremely talented in martial arts. He is a rare genius that is rare in a thousand years. If this thing hadn't happened, he might have started to retreat to condense the golden elixir of martial arts."
Shen Qingyu took out a handkerchief and wiped his sweat: "You are right, but today the genius has become a useless person. He doesn't even care about his own family members, let alone outsiders."
Xiaoli looked at the Yun family with the door closed, and was speechless for a moment.
When Mr. Yun was shining brightly, everyone licked their faces to soak up the light, but after the light disappeared, they were abandoned like worn-out shoes. Even my own family members are like this, let alone outsiders.
"It's a pity that a generation of genius has died."
"This is none of our business. It's too hot. Let's go to Hantan."
"Actually, the cold pool that Your Highness is going to was originally home to an ice dragon. If Mr. Yun hadn't killed it at the risk of his life, His Highness might not have been able to soak in it. And it's because of this ice dragon that Mr. Yun fell into this situation."
Shen Qingyu was slightly stunned, surprised that this happened.
But this didn't seem to have anything to do with her. She was very hot, and something wasn't right about the fire spirit grass. She had to go take a dip in the cold pool quickly.
As he was squeezing out of the crowd, a voice suddenly came from above his head, which sounded a little urgent.
【etc. 】
Something flew over her head, and Shen Qingyu took a closer look. Sure enough, as she had guessed, the Great Abyss Dragon Veins had become essence.
She said nothing, and her eyes signaled Xiaoli to move faster.
When the little dragon pulse circled around Yun Jue for a few times and then flew back, it was stunned when it found that the person was gone.
[Where is Your Majesty? Where is Your Majesty in such a big house? 】
(ㄒoㄒ)~~
Shen Qingyu ran away very fast, murmuring in her heart: Good fellow, since you have become spiritually intelligent, why don't you follow the new emperor of Dayuan instead of following her, a weak little white flower who can't take care of herself?
As soon as the carriage drove out of the city gate, the sky suddenly darkened, and then a strong wind blew up.
Seeing that it was going to rain, they had to find a place to stop and take shelter.
The octagonal pavilion, which had been in disrepair for a long time, could block the rain but not the wind. Shen Qingyu was blown around by the wind. He was supported by Lan Ying and Xiaoli on the left and right, so that he was not blown down by the wind. It was his face that was a little painful and his facial features were flying around.
"The sky outside the city is really changing more and more." Xiaoli muttered.
Lan Ying didn't speak, his eyes scanned the surroundings vigilantly.
Often at this time, demons are most likely to cause trouble.
The wind finally stopped, and the rain began to pour again, as if the day had been broken.
